fullRerunAdmission.primaryQuestion: Do exact content-bound names select all current producer receipts on a real complete workflow rerun?

interpretations: The fixed-name rerun consumer rejected an older archive; content-bound names passed both actual attempts.
The historical selector-control receipt deliberately preserves its then-false cloudWorkaroundVerified field; the later cloud phases establish the workaround independently.
Raw aggregate failure includes intentionally failed parallel jobs and a cancelled timeout. Ordinary job-level continuation remains a separate isolated comparison.
Both normal parallel and allrun blocks have observed later sibling completion; no descendant-termination guarantee is asserted.
Each step retry retains filesystem state; the full rerun has new provider sandbox identities and freshly generated receipt hashes.
Raw action logs may contain signed URLs and are kept private; only filtered numeric-ID/digest/error events and raw-log hashes are public.
Native archive verification uses API byte sizes, local SHA256 and CRC; no native server-provided digest is claimed.
Terminal API states and budget reservations do not prove deallocation timing or actual billing.
